name: circle-carousel-2
title: Spiral carousel
description: Covers wind inward on a spiral. They are born at the rim and swallowed at the centre.

props.name: images
props.doc: Pictures, as paths under public/ (or full URLs). They repeat when there are fewer than the count.

props.name: count
props.doc: How many covers ride the spiral.

props.name: outerRadius
props.doc: Radius of the rim, where the covers are born, in px.

props.name: innerRadius
props.doc: Radius at the end of the spiral, where the largest cover sits, in px.

props.name: windings
props.doc: How many times the spiral winds round on its way in.

props.name: minSize
props.doc: Side of the smallest cover, in px.

props.name: maxSize
props.doc: Side of the largest cover, in px.

props.name: growth
props.doc: How late the covers grow; higher keeps them small until near the centre.

props.name: travel
props.doc: How far the covers travel along the spiral over the shot, as a fraction of its length.

props.name: travelStart
props.doc: Frame the covers start moving.

props.name: travelFrames
props.doc: Frames the travel takes, eased in and out.

props.name: swirl
props.doc: Degrees the whole spiral turns over the shot, on top of the covers travelling along it.

props.name: tilt
props.doc: Degrees each cover leans along the spiral.

props.name: stagger
props.doc: Frames between one cover appearing and the next.

props.name: rideZoom
props.doc: Zoom of the opening shot on the smallest covers.

props.name: push
props.doc: How far the camera pushes into the largest cover at the end.

props.name: motionBlur
props.doc: Camera motion blur shutter in frames, used while the camera moves fast. 0 turns it off.

props.name: title
props.doc: Small title at the bottom right. Empty for none.

props.name: caption
props.doc: Smaller line under the title. Empty for none.

props.name: font
props.doc: Google Fonts family for the label.

props.name: colors.ground
props.doc: Background.

props.name: colors.ink
props.doc: Title.

props.name: colors.muted
props.doc: Caption.
